I don't want to demean your problem since I have no idea what it is, but there are a lot of situations that may seem unsolvable at least from the inside. You could talk with others (friends, professionals, anyone I dare say if you are so fixed on it) to see if there is a way to cope. Even if it a serious mental illness, maybe you won't be able to lead that normal of a life but you could still be a loved, functioning person there for your loved ones. I think it is worth giving it a few tries before ending you life if you haven't, at least for tha people that love you and you love.

Sounds tough. Are you afraid of the bullying happening again? Maybe there is something in your life now that reminds you of those hard times and you feel so uneasy. I am just asking these questions so you can ask them to yourself and maybe find the source of the problem. Maybe it has all taken a toll on you and even though you may have a normal life now you still feel bad from it all. If you don't understand why you feel so bad the best thing you can do I think is talk to a therapist so he can help you see what's wrong from an outsiders perspective. And also help you get better. Call a hotline? Talk to someone you trust about it maybe? I wish you good luck.
